index.description.001: E-Ink Assistant yana daidaita bambancin haske, bayanan inuwa da launi a allunan tawadar lantarki don macOS da Windows.
index.text.002: E-Ink Assistant don macOS da Windows
index.text.012:
Daidaita allonka na tawadar lantarki
bisa abin da kake yi.
index.text.013: Daidaita bambancin hasken rubutu, bayanan inuwa da launi a allunan tawadar lantarki da ka zaɓa. Sauran allunanka ba za su canza ba.
index.text.016: ★Ba da tauraro a GitHub
index.aria-label.018: Manhajar E-Ink Assistant da aka nuna a allo
index.alt.019: Manyan masu sarrafa E-Ink Assistant cikin Turanci
index.aria-label.021: Abubuwan da samfurin zai iya yi
index.text.022: BAMBANCIN HASKEN RUBUTU ✦ BAYANAN INUWA ✦ ƘARFIN LAUNI + RGB ✦ SAITUNAN KOWANE ALLO ✦ BAMBANCIN HASKEN RUBUTU ✦ BAYANAN INUWA ✦ ƘARFIN LAUNI + RGB ✦ SAITUNAN KOWANE ALLO ✦
index.text.023: 01 / ABIN DA MASU SARRAFAWA SUKE YI
index.text.024:
Zaɓi mai sarrafawa
bisa abin da ake nunawa.
index.text.025: Bambancin hasken rubutu yana duhun shafukan karatu. Inganta bidiyo yana bayyana bayanan hoton da suke duhu. Ƙarfin launi da RGB suna taimaka wa allunan tawadar lantarki masu launi.
index.alt.026: Misalin bambancin hasken shafin karatu kafin da bayan
index.text.028: Yana duhun rubutun jiki da na sakandare marasa fitowa sosai don karatu.
index.alt.029: Misalin hoton shimfidar wuri da bayanan inuwa kafin da bayan
index.text.031: Yana haskaka sautunan hotuna da bidiyo masu duhu don bayyana bayanan inuwa.
index.alt.032: Misalin hoton tsirrai a tawadar lantarki mai launi kafin da bayan
index.text.034: Rama launuka masu dusashewa da Ƙarfin launi da RGB.
index.text.035: Waɗannan samfoti ne na misali. Sakamako ya bambanta bisa allo da asalin abin da ake nunawa.
index.text.039:
Masu sarrafawa na bai ɗaya.
Iyakokin kowane tsari.
index.text.040: Manhajar tana amfani da masu sarrafa allo na jama'a da ake samu a kowane tsarin aiki. Ana ɓoye masu sarrafawa marasa tallafi ko a bayyana dalilinsu.
index.text.042: Bambancin hasken rubutu, Inganta bidiyo, lanƙwasoshi, saitunan da aka riga aka tsara, da saitunan kowane allo.
index.text.044: Rage rawa da sarrafa Night Shift / True Tone ga kowane allo.
index.text.046: Tsarukan Windows 10 2004 da Windows 11 21H2+ da suka dace; samuwa ya dogara da tsarin da kayan aiki.
index.text.048: Sa rubutu marar fitowa sosai ya fi duhu
index.text.049: Bambancin hasken rubutu yana ba da matakai huɗu don shafuka masu ƙarancin bambancin haske.
index.text.050: Yi amfani da shi don karatu; ya bambanta da Inganta bidiyo.
index.text.053: Inganta bidiyo yana haskaka bayanan inuwa a hotuna da bidiyo.
index.text.054: Kashe shi don karatu domin yana haskaka rubutu mai duhu ma.
index.text.057: Yi amfani da saitunan da aka riga aka tsara ko masu sarrafawa kai tsaye don rama ƙarancin faɗin launuka.
index.text.058: Samuwa ya dogara da tsarin aiki, GPU, direba, da hanyar fitar da hoto zuwa allo.
index.text.061: Yi wa allunan tawadar lantarki da kake son manhajar ta canza alama kawai.
index.text.062: Ajiye lanƙwasoshi don alluna daban-daban kuma maido da saituna lokacin fita daga manhajar.
index.alt.063: Masu sarrafa lanƙwasar sautuna na ci gaba na E-Ink Assistant cikin Turanci
index.text.065:
Daidaita lanƙwasar
idan saitunan da aka riga aka tsara ba su isa ba.
index.text.066: Canza maɓallin lanƙwasawa, gamma, matsayin baƙi, da matsayin fari yayin kallon lanƙwasar.
index.text.067: Ajiye saituna masu suna har guda biyar. Ana ajiye saituna daban ga kowane allo.
index.aria-label.069: Kwatanta fasalolin macOS da Windows mai iya gungurawa
index.text.080: I. Sauran alluna ba sa canzawa.
index.text.082: Matakai huɗu: Matsakaici, Mai ƙarfi, Mai kaifi, Mai kauri
index.text.083: Matakai uku: Mai sauƙi, Matsakaici, Mai ƙarfi
index.text.084: Lanƙwasa na ci gaba da saitunan da aka riga aka tsara
index.text.085: Editan lanƙwasa kai tsaye da saituna masu suna guda biyar
index.text.087: Bayanin launi ga kowane allo; ƙarfin launi 0%–300% da RGB 0%–200%
index.text.088: Ana samunsa a tsarukan Windows 10 2004 da Windows 11 21H2+ da suka dace; hanyar da ake samu ta dogara da tsarin da kayan aiki
index.text.090: Ana samunsa a allunan waje masu tallafi; yana kunnawa idan an yi wa allo alamar tawadar lantarki
index.text.091: Ba ya samuwa. Windows ba ya da mai sarrafa haɗa launi da ɗigon pixels na jama'a guda ɗaya ga kowane allo, kuma mai yiwuwa yawancin tsarukan Windows ba sa buƙatarsa.
index.text.093: Ana samunsa ta mataimaki da mai amfani yake tabbatarwa sau ɗaya
index.text.094: Ana samunsa daga Windows 7 SP1 ta APIs na tsarin da suka dace
index.text.097: Yanayin haske na Windows na zaman aiki kawai a Windows 10 1903+
index.text.099: Keɓe kowane allo daga Night Shift da True Tone; yana buƙatar amincewar mai gudanarwa da sake haɗawa
index.text.100: Saitunan Hasken dare daga Windows 10 1703+; mai sarrafa Kashe Hasken dare kai tsaye a Windows 11 24H2+
index.text.102: Har yanzu ana iya zaɓar allunan zahiri masu madubi ɗaya-ɗaya
index.text.103: Lanƙwasoshin sautuna suna shafar tushen da aka raba; Ƙarfin launi da RGB suna buƙatar yanayin Faɗaɗa
index.text.105: Ana maido da lanƙwasoshi, bayanan launi da haɗa launi da ɗigon pixels na ɗan lokaci yayin fita; keɓewa daga Night Shift / True Tone yana dawwama
index.text.106: Ana maido da canje-canjen gamma, launi, gani, da Hasken dare na ɗan lokaci yayin fita; launi da Hasken dare suna kuma dawowa bayan fita ba bisa ƙa'ida ba
index.text.109: Harsunan fuska a abubuwan saukewa na yanzu
index.text.110: Turanci, Sinanci mai sauƙi, Sinanci na gargajiya, Jafananci
index.text.112: Don keɓewa daga Night Shift / True Tone na zaɓi kawai
index.text.113: Mai shigarwa da manhajar suna buƙatarsa
index.text.115:
Sa allonka na tawadar lantarki
ya dace da kai.
index.text.116: Dukkan nau'ikan biyu kyauta ne kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe ne.
index.text.117: macOS 2.6↓Windows 1.2↓
index.text.118: macOS 14+ Apple silicon · Windows 7 SP1–11 x64
index.text.123: Gwada buɗe manhajar sau ɗaya. Idan macOS ya hana ta, buɗe Saitunan tsarin → Sirri & Tsaro kuma zaɓi Buɗe duk da haka.
index.text.124: Wannan manhaja ce da aka ƙirƙira da kanta kuma ba ta cikin App Store a yanzu. macOS zai nuna gargaɗin “an kasa tabbatarwa” lokacin da ka fara buɗe ta. Lambar gaba ɗaya buɗaɗɗen tushe ce, don haka za ka iya duba ta kafin yanke shawarar amfani da ita.
index.text.125: Idan “Buɗe duk da haka” bai bayyana ba
index.text.126: Bayan ka matsar da manhajar zuwa Manhajoji, buɗe Terminal kuma gudanar da:
index.text.128: Sauke macOS 2.6 ↓Idan yana taimaka maka, ba wa aikin tauraro a GitHub ↗
index.text.131: Sauke kuma gudanar da fayil ɗin shigarwa.
index.text.133: Buɗe E‑Ink Assistant daga menu na Fara ko tiren tsarin.
index.text.134: Don Windows 7 SP1 zuwa Windows 11 a kwamfutocin x64. Masu sarrafawa da ake samu sun dogara da nau'in Windows, GPU, direba, da haɗin allo.
index.text.135: Sauke Windows 1.2 ↓Idan yana taimaka maka, ba wa aikin tauraro a GitHub ↗
changelog.description.138: Tarihin fitowar nau'ikan macOS da Windows na E-Ink Assistant.
changelog.text.145: An inganta tallafin alluna masu madubi.
changelog.text.146: Allunan sakandare da kayan aiki suke madubantawa har yanzu ana iya zaɓar su ɗaya-ɗaya, kuma ana daidaita su bisa fitarwar zahiri.
changelog.text.147: Sauyawa tsakanin tsarin alluna na madubi da faɗaɗa yana sabuntawa da sake amfani da saitunan allo nan da nan.
changelog.text.148: Sake amfani da saituna da maido da su lokacin fita suna taɓa allunan tawadar lantarki da aka yi wa alama kawai, har da allunan madubi da suke haɗe.
changelog.text.149: Shawarar saiti yanzu tana nuna wa masu amfani menu na allon kansa a sarari.
changelog.text.151: An ƙara taƙaitacciyar jagorar saita kayan aiki.
changelog.text.152: Tunatarwa mai iya rufewa yanzu tana bayyana sama da masu sarrafawa, da misalin Bigme B251 Pro.
changelog.text.153: Na fahimta yana ɓoye tunatarwar don zaman aiki; Kada a sake nunawa yana ci gaba bayan sake buɗewa.
changelog.text.154: Kwamitin maraba yanzu yana amfani da gajerun bayanan saiti uku masu alamomi.
changelog.text.155: Allunan da ke cikin na'ura yanzu suna bayyana bayan allunan waje a jerin zaɓi.
changelog.text.158: Tsayin kwamitin yana bin allon yanzu.
changelog.text.159: Kwamitin sarrafawa yanzu yana amfani da tsayin da ake iya gani na allon da yake ɗauke da abin sandar menu.
changelog.text.160: Ana gungura dogon abun ciki kuma yana barin maki 40 sama da Dock ko gefen allo. Gajerun kwamitoci suna riƙe tsayinsu na halitta.
changelog.text.162: An canza ƙimomin saitunan Bambancin hasken rubutu.
changelog.text.163: Matsakaici yana amfani da tsohuwar lanƙwasar Mai ƙarfi. Mai ƙarfi, Mai kaifi, da Mai kauri suna ƙara duhu a jere.
changelog.text.164: Mai kaifi yana amfani da gamma 5.00 da matsayin baƙi 0.10. Mai kauri yana amfani da gamma 6.00 da matsayin baƙi 0.34. Dukansu suna cire ƙarin bayanan toka kuma suna samar da gefuna masu tauri.
changelog.text.167: An gyara sauya harshe a Yadda yake aiki.
changelog.text.168: Taken ɓangaren da maɓallin Nuna ƙari / Nuna kaɗan yanzu suna sabuntawa nan da nan idan harshen manhajar ya canza.
changelog.text.171: Mataimakin zai iya aiki yayin da Mac yake a kulle, yana hana gargaɗin Shortcuts lokacin cire haɗi da maido da saituna.
changelog.text.172: Masu sabuntawa daga v2.0 dole su ƙara mataimakin da aka sake wa suna sau ɗaya, sannan za su iya cire tsohon.
changelog.text.175: An ƙara masu sarrafa allo, harsuna, da mai shigarwa DMG.
changelog.text.176: An ƙara masu sarrafa RGB, Night Shift, da True Tone ga kowane allo.
changelog.text.177: An ƙara mai sarrafa Rage ganin bayan abubuwa da motsi ta mataimakin Shortcuts da mai amfani ya tabbatar.
changelog.text.178: An ƙara Turanci, Sinanci mai sauƙi, Sinanci na gargajiya, da Jafananci.
changelog.text.180: An ƙara sarrafa Night Shift da True Tone ga kowane allo.
changelog.text.181: Canjin yana buƙatar kalmar sirrin mai gudanarwa da sake haɗa allo. Ba a soke shi idan an fita daga manhajar ba.
changelog.text.184: An ƙara Rage rawa, Ƙarfin launi, Bambancin hasken rubutu, Inganta bidiyo, lanƙwasoshin sautuna na musamman, guraben ajiye lanƙwasa, da maido da allo lokacin fita.
changelog.text.187: An inganta maido da masu sarrafa launi.
changelog.text.188: An gyara gargaɗin ƙarya na gazawar fasali idan Windows ya samar da hanyar sarrafa launi amma bai ba manhajar damar canza halinta ba.
changelog.text.189: Ana riƙe bayanan maido yayin da yanayin Kwafi ya kashe sarrafa launi na ɗan lokaci, sannan a maido da su idan tsarin alluna mai iya sarrafawa ya dawo.
changelog.text.191: An ƙara Bambancin hasken rubutu, Inganta bidiyo, lanƙwasoshi na ci gaba, saitunan kowane allo, da zaɓin allunan tawadar lantarki.
changelog.text.192: An ƙara masu sarrafa Ƙarfin launi, RGB, Yanayin haske na Windows, da Hasken dare da suka dace, tare da maido da saituna da farfaɗowa bayan faɗuwa.
changelog.text.193: An ƙara kula da alluna masu kwafi, gabatarwar tiren tsarin, buɗewa lokacin shiga, sabuntawa, da mai shigarwa mai harsuna da yawa.
